notes.title: Release date revealed
notes.notes:
You know what, I'm in a good mood. Tomorrow is my birthday and we are going into the release month for Collision: First-Third. So here's a little surprise.

Collision: First-Third releases July 29 for Steam.  

More info will be released every day before July 29th starting July 10th.  Each day, it will be somewhere different. Twitter(@mildraingames), or Steam community.  HAVE FUNN!!!!
